subject: Neymar finishes 10th in a poker tournament and wins 24,000 dollars
title: Neymar's poker run

lines.vo: Neymar paid fifteen thousand dollars and left with twenty-four thousand.
He finished tenth in an invitation-only Super High Roller event at BSOP Millions. Even his hobbies have a guest list.
One hundred and fifty-two entries and a one point two million dollar prize pool. Tenth is about the top seven percent. Not bad for a man who changes his hair more often than his strategy.
He played for more than eight hours. That is four football matches without a single sprint. Then Pedro Neves, the twenty twenty-four world champion, knocked him out.
Two nights earlier he was twelfth in a four thousand dollar buy-in event.
Last year he was twenty-ninth in the Brazilian Series of Poker. Twenty-ninth, twelfth, tenth. Progress, Neymar.

inserts.story: Setup: a cutout Neymar walks up to a velvet-rope poker table. Gag: a cutout bouncer checks a guest list with one line on it: NEYMAR. Twist: the bouncer asks for ID and Neymar holds up a football.
inserts.characters: South Park style cutout Neymar; cutout bouncer with clipboard

inserts.story: Setup: a generic cutout champion in a shiny suit slides a giant playing-card trophy onto the table. Gag: the trophy is too big and pushes every chip off the felt. Twist: the chips land in tiny cutout Neymar's lap and he calmly says REMATCH.
inserts.characters: generic cutout champion (not a real likeness); cutout Neymar

inserts.story: Setup: cutout Neymar holds up last year's leaderboard showing 29TH. Gag: he rubs the number out with one finger and writes 12TH, then 10TH. Twist: he claps once, very quietly, and the board politely claps back.

notes: Comic, 3 inserts (after_line counts from 1). Poker content only, no gambling advice, no claim about winning. CTA says tips/news/predictions with no promise of results.
